decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a niche product with limited strategic fit and only minor website presence, making discontinuation likely.
Industrial explosion-proof luminaires align with the firm's core industrial electrical equipment business and have received ongoing investment such as an LED replacement kit.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product, indicating proven demand and brand recognition.
Pendant office luminaires serve the core office lighting market and are still within a normal product lifecycle.
The premium pendant luminaire targets a higher-margin segment and has no indication of underperformance.
